description: Soccer competition stats for 16 leagues (Premier League, LaLiga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, Süper Lig, MLS, Champions League …): league table (rank, team, played, W/D/L, goals for/against, goal difference, points, qualification note; any season), or current-season top scorers / top assists with appearances, goals, assists and club. Data from ESPN's public soccer API (FBref blocks automated access). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
